timeoff_raw_help: Paste your .hday content below (or load a file), click Apply, then export if needed. Flags: a=half AM, p=half PM, b=business, e=weekend, h=birthday, i=ill, k=in, s=course, u=other, w=onsite, n=no fly, f=can fly; weekly: d1-d7 (Mon-Sun) with flags after (e.g., d3ab for Wed AM business).

Example:
2024/12/23-2025/01/05 # Winter break
p2024/07/17-2024/07/17
d3ab # Wednesday AM business
